name: What So Not
description:
'''What So Not''' is an electronic music project by Australian DJ and record producer '''Emoh Instead''' (stage name of '''Christopher John Emerson'''). What So Not has toured the world, playing at various festivals, including [[Coachella]], [[Bonnaroo]], [[Ultra Music Festival]], and [[Lollapalooza]]. 

He is best known for songs such as "Jaguar", "High You Are", "Gemini" (featuring [[George Maple]]), "Tell Me" (with [[RL Grime]]), and his remix of [[Rüfüs Du Sol]]'s "[[Innerbloom]]". He has featured on charts such as the [[ARIA Charts|Australian Singles chart]], [[Triple J Hottest 100]], and the USA iTunes Dance Album chart. He released his debut studio album ''[[Not All the Beautiful Things]]'' on 9 March 2018.
